specification.source_normalization: position/.1m; physical velocity/(2pi*.1m/s), except historical previous5ms mean velocity
specification.reference_definition: Independent event-split DOP853 solution of coupled activation, movement and chosen favorable coefficient ODE; right-continuous instantaneous derivative at physical apertures.
specification.delivery_scope: Predetermined whole 3mA/200us-per-phase/40Hz-frame admitted-profile replay, normalized true dose1 per selected route. Evaluator assumption; no qualified monitor, hardware delivery or causal adaptive stimulation claim.

fit_boundary.split: Legacy clean calibration, chronological75/25 with100ms purge each side and differentiated labels constructed inside partitions. Evaluation recording/noise IDs independent of calibration IDs. Same scripted subject trajectory is reused to isolate aperture/source approximation; no independent task/human generalization claim.

specification.ambiguity: Paired distinct foot-swapped trajectories through a deliberately rank-deficient lead field; same exact physical noise and indistinguishable measured features, conflicting observed external positions.
claim_limits: Finite synthetic voltage-source and sample-aperture study; no claim that spinal contacts encode these four chosen movement variables.
Source-hold failures are retained. Fine integration cannot repair noninjective fields, residual artifact uncertainty or absent information.
Observed conflict abstention uses already-available external measurements; no universal unknown-state ambiguity detector.
No retained-learning, consumer efficacy, neural incremental value, safe implant or optimized electrode-placement qualification.

reproduction.reference_witness_policy: Validate each maximum-position witness independently, including its coarse/fine positions recomputed at its own physical aperture using the frozen study subject/scenario/reference grids. If both maxima are below the fixed absolute reproduction tolerance, its argmax location is a roundoff diagnostic and may differ; all maxima, budgets, decisions and other numeric observations remain compared.
reproduction.noise_policy: Within each execution, actual paired draws/hashes, generator states and observational schedules must be exactly equal. Across executions, raw numeric witnesses use declared tolerance; RNG states/counts exact, empirical moments numeric. Byte hashes and solver evaluation counts are platform diagnostics.

batch_summary.scope: Numeric reference checks and observation-boundary invariants pass. Source approximation failures, dense residual failure, negative information controls and ambiguous mapping remain; this does not establish real spinal observability.
